task.title: Upload reviewed Native Build 55 to TestFlight

The dry run passed every authentication, identity, signing, dSYM, monotonic-build, and duplicate-upload gate. review.summary: The previously completed fresh-context final review of candidate 621dbef3 reported no blocker, major, or moderate findings. The source worktree was clean and remained at that exact SHA before and after archive creation.

No Server endpoint, production database command, link-confirmation operation, or policy mutation was invoked. The existing Sep 23 link therefore remains an unconfirmed quarantined candidate, and strategic eligibility remains unchanged.
